In-house work experience also an added advantage. content_sections.heading: Madurai Kamaraj University Subject Expert / Professional Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Subject Expert / Professional will handle the Classes for the Programme M.Sc., Visual Communication with specialization of the following subjects: Graphic Animation (2D, 3D) VFX AR VR UI & UX Designing & Editing Videography Photography AV Film Making etc.
